reason: The analyst controlled for collab_index_2023, a 2023 post-treatment variable (mediator or collider), which flips the sign. My own full-control specification without it gives about +0.75 (p=0.001), whereas the controlled-for-collab version gives about -2.1, so the 'negative effect' conclusion is an artifact. The analyst also trimmed on the outcome, omitted most pre-period covariates, and ran only one specification with no robustness checks.
